name: @gatemcp/cli

tools.name: gate_compress_file
tools.description: AST/structure file compression. Code: signature. YAML/MD: auto structure. See gate_help recommended_stack.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the code file

depth.description: signature (AST, default), structure (YAML/MD keys), summary (code only), full (raw)

projectRoot.description: Optional project root (narrows GATE_PROJECT_ROOT; cannot widen). Use for multi-repo workspaces.

tools.name: gate_graph_query
tools.description: Symbol graph + graphify map. graphify_map/search/hubs for communities. search auto-fallback. See gate_help recommended_stack.

query.description: Symbol name, file name, or search term to query

queryType.description: Symbol: search | depends_on | dependents | file_symbols | stats | symbol_map | export_html. Graphify map (nested graphify-out/): graphify_hubs | graphify_search | graphify_map. search auto-fallback to graphify when 0 symbol hits.

tools.name: gate_init
tools.description: Project health: graphify map, dedup cache path, MCP slug hint. Run once per repo. See gate_help.

tools.name: gate_session_stats
tools.description: Measured file/byte/token work plus dedup cache activity. See gate_help gate_session_stats.

projectRoot.description: Optional project root for persistent cache totals (same as gate_compress_file).

tools.name: gate_invoke
tools.description: Catalog mode: call any Gate tool by name with args. Use for tools not in tools/list. See gate_help.

tool.description: Gate tool name, e.g. gate_memory or gate_clean_response

args.description: Arguments object for the target tool

tools.name: gate_help
tools.description: Full docs for any Gate-MCP tool. tool='recommended_stack' for navigation playbook; omit for directory.

tool.description: Tool name to get docs for, or omit for directory
